name: AI-Powered-Insurance-Claims-Automation-Accelerator
headline: AI-Powered Insurance Claims Automation Accelerator
short_description: The AI-Powered Insurance Claims Automation Accelerator streamlines claim processing using advanced AI capabilities. It enhances customer experience by reducing manual effort and processing time through intelligent handling of images, IDs, and documents.
author: MSUSAzureAccelerators

sections.overview:
This accelerator uses Azure machine learning and Form Recognizer to automate insurance claims processing. Customers submit claims through a voice-activated chatbot and upload supporting documents like driver's licenses, insurance cards, and damage photos. The system automatically extracts metadata from documents using built-in and custom AI models, stores data in Cosmos DB, and indexes documents in Azure Cognitive Search. This eliminates manual data entry, reduces processing time, and enables instant repair or replacement estimates, improving customer satisfaction while decreasing operational overhead.
Automating document verification for claims
Speeding up image processing for claim approvals
Reducing manual data entry in insurance claims
Enhancing customer support through automated claim inquiries
